title: Single Wheelset Kalker Creepage Stability
description: Single standard-gauge railway wheelset with S1002 tread profile and primary yaw/lateral suspension stiffnesses to evaluate Klingel kinematic oscillation and Kalker creepage stability.
code:
# GENSYS Model: Single Wheelset Kalker Creepage Stability
# Standard 1435 mm track gauge, S1002 tread profile, 0.46 m wheel radius
set m_ws = 1500.0
set r_nom = 0.46

body axle_frame 1200.0 650.0 950.0 1100.0 0.0 0.0 0.50
wheelset ws1 m_ws 1.435 r_nom 0.05 "S1002_profile.wheel"

# Primary longitudinal, lateral, and vertical suspension to reference frame
spring prim_susp ws1 axle_frame 9000000 4000000 1200000 15000 12000 20000
spring frame_gnd axle_frame ground 100000 500000 800000 5000 10000 15000

title: Two-Axle Freight Wagon Tangent Track Hunting
description: Two-axle UIC freight wagon with tare carbody inertia, leaf-spring primary suspension couplings, and standard S1002 wheelsets for tangent-track critical hunting speed analysis.
code:
# GENSYS Model: Two-Axle Freight Wagon Tangent Track Hunting
# Wheelbase = 9.0 m, standard gauge 1.435 m
set m_wagon = 14500.0
set kx_leaf = 4500000.0
set ky_leaf = 1800000.0
set kz_leaf = 1650000.0

body wagon_body m_wagon 28000.0 420000.0 410000.0 0.0 0.0 1.45
wheelset ws_lead 1350.0 1.435 0.46 0.08 "S1002_freight.wheel"
wheelset ws_trail 1350.0 1.435 0.46 0.08 "S1002_freight.wheel"

# Parabolic leaf-spring primary suspension couplings
spring susp_lead wagon_body ws_lead kx_leaf ky_leaf kz_leaf 18000 14000 22000
spring susp_trail wagon_body ws_trail kx_leaf ky_leaf kz_leaf 18000 14000 22000

title: Passenger Bogie Curved Track Flange Contact
description: Two-axle passenger bogie with bolster, primary chevron springs, secondary air springs, and anti-yaw dampers configured for tight-curve flange contact and Nadal Y/Q derailment evaluation.
code:
# GENSYS Model: Passenger Bogie Curved Track Flange Contact (Nadal Y/Q)
# Bogie wheelbase 2.50 m, primary chevron springs, secondary air springs
set m_cb_half = 16000.0
set m_bogie = 2850.0

body carbody_half m_cb_half 34000.0 820000.0 810000.0 0.0 0.0 1.65
body bogie_frame m_bogie 1950.0 1750.0 3200.0 0.0 0.0 0.55

wheelset ws_front 1520.0 1.435 0.46 0.10 "S1002_worn.wheel"
wheelset ws_rear 1520.0 1.435 0.46 0.10 "S1002_worn.wheel"

# Secondary air-spring and yaw damper suspension
spring sec_air carbody_half bogie_frame 165000 155000 420000 28000 32000 42000

# Primary axlebox coil and chevron springs
spring prim_front bogie_frame ws_front 8500000 3800000 1180000 14000 11000 19000
spring prim_rear bogie_frame ws_rear 8500000 3800000 1180000 14000 11000 19000

title: Four-Axle High-Speed Coach with Track Irregularity
description: Full 4-axle 250 km/h high-speed passenger coach with front and rear bogies, secondary air springs, primary axlebox suspensions, a companion run control file, and measured track irregularity profile.
code:
# GENSYS Model: Full 4-Axle High-Speed Passenger Coach (250 km/h)
# Pivot distance = 19.0 m, bogie wheelbase = 2.50 m
set m_car = 34000.0
set m_bogie = 2750.0
set m_ws = 1480.0

body carbody m_car 68000.0 1920000.0 1850000.0 0.0 0.0 1.72
body bogie_front m_bogie 1900.0 1700.0 3150.0 9.5 0.0 0.55
body bogie_rear m_bogie 1900.0 1700.0 3150.0 -9.5 0.0 0.55

wheelset ws1 m_ws 1.435 0.46 0.05 "S1002_hs.wheel"
wheelset ws2 m_ws 1.435 0.46 0.05 "S1002_hs.wheel"
wheelset ws3 m_ws 1.435 0.46 0.05 "S1002_hs.wheel"
wheelset ws4 m_ws 1.435 0.46 0.05 "S1002_hs.wheel"

# Secondary air springs & yaw dampers
spring sec_front carbody bogie_front 150000 145000 410000 26000 30000 38000
spring sec_rear carbody bogie_rear 150000 145000 410000 26000 30000 38000

# Primary axlebox suspensions
spring prim_1 bogie_front ws1 9500000 4200000 1200000 15000 12000 20000
spring prim_2 bogie_front ws2 9500000 4200000 1200000 15000 12000 20000
spring prim_3 bogie_rear ws3 9500000 4200000 1200000 15000 12000 20000
spring prim_4 bogie_rear ws4 9500000 4200000 1200000 15000 12000 20000

sub track_irreg

title: Articulated Tilting Trainset EN 14363 Certification
description: Two-car articulated tilting trainset with shared Jacobs bogie, active roll-tilt bolster actuators, EN 14363 homologation run script, and companion S1002 wheel and UIC60 rail profile sub-files.
code:
# GENSYS Model: Two-Car Articulated Tilting Trainset (EN 14363 Certification)
# Shared center Jacobs bogie + front/rear end bogies + tilting bolsters
set m_car = 31500.0
set m_bogie = 2900.0
set m_bolster = 680.0
set m_ws = 1520.0

body car_a m_car 62000.0 1680000.0 1620000.0 10.5 0.0 1.68
body car_b m_car 62000.0 1680000.0 1620000.0 -10.5 0.0 1.68
body bolster_a m_bolster 420.0 380.0 610.0 10.5 0.0 0.88
body bolster_b m_bolster 420.0 380.0 610.0 -10.5 0.0 0.88

body bogie_front m_bogie 2050.0 1850.0 3300.0 18.0 0.0 0.55
body bogie_jacobs 3250.0 2300.0 2100.0 3650.0 0.0 0.0 0.55
body bogie_rear m_bogie 2050.0 1850.0 3300.0 -18.0 0.0 0.55

wheelset ws1 m_ws 1.435 0.46 0.06 "s1002_wheel.sub"
wheelset ws2 m_ws 1.435 0.46 0.06 "s1002_wheel.sub"
wheelset ws3 m_ws 1.435 0.46 0.06 "s1002_wheel.sub"
wheelset ws4 m_ws 1.435 0.46 0.06 "s1002_wheel.sub"
wheelset ws5 m_ws 1.435 0.46 0.06 "s1002_wheel.sub"
wheelset ws6 m_ws 1.435 0.46 0.06 "s1002_wheel.sub"

# Active tilt bolster couplings
spring tilt_a car_a bolster_a 450000 320000 680000 35000 28000 45000
spring tilt_b car_b bolster_b 450000 320000 680000 35000 28000 45000

# Secondary air springs & inter-car articulation
spring sec_front bolster_a bogie_front 155000 150000 420000 28000 32000 40000
spring sec_jac_a car_a bogie_jacobs 195000 185000 460000 32000 36000 44000
spring sec_jac_b car_b bogie_jacobs 195000 185000 460000 32000 36000 44000
spring sec_rear bolster_b bogie_rear 155000 150000 420000 28000 32000 40000

# Primary axlebox suspensions
spring p1 bogie_front ws1 9200000 4100000 1220000 15000 12000 20000
spring p2 bogie_front ws2 9200000 4100000 1220000 15000 12000 20000
spring p3 bogie_jacobs ws3 9600000 4300000 1280000 16000 13000 21000
spring p4 bogie_jacobs ws4 9600000 4300000 1280000 16000 13000 21000
spring p5 bogie_rear ws5 9200000 4100000 1220000 15000 12000 20000
spring p6 bogie_rear ws6 9200000 4100000 1220000 15000 12000 20000

sub s1002_wheel
sub uic60_rail
